summary: Verified customer pickup-confirmation feature (iteration 10). Backend: PUT customer & merchant /confirmation endpoints reachable with no body and return 404 (not 405) for non-existent orders. Source code contains confirmCustomerOrderReceived export in utils/api.ts and confirm-pickup-btn- testID in my-orders.tsx. Built web bundle at /app/frontend/dist contains all required new strings ('Order Delivered', 'I Picked Up My Order', 'Waiting for merchant to mark delivery', 'confirmCustomerOrderReceived') and no longer contains 'Confirm Delivery'. Both /my-orders and /merchant-orders pages render without crashing on preview URL at mobile viewport 390x844.

ui_bugs.issue: When customer_id is not in AsyncStorage, the page stays stuck on 'Loading your orders...' spinner forever instead of showing the expected 'Please log in as a customer to view your orders.' empty state. The loading useEffect only sets loading=false when customerId is truthy, so unauth users never see the fallback.

issues: React error #418 (hydration mismatch) is logged on page load in the minified bundle. Not blocking, likely pre-existing Expo web SSR/hydration issue.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In my-orders.tsx set loading=false when customerId is null (else block on the mount effect), so unauth users see the 'Please log in' empty state instead of an infinite spinner.
OPTIONAL: Investigate React #418 hydration mismatch on my-orders/merchant-orders web builds (pre-existing, low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: confirmCustomerOrderReceived correctly PUTs with no body and Accept:*/* header — matches merchant counterpart.
Waiting banner condition (customerReceivedAt truthy && status !== COMPLETED) is correct.
Consider hiding the 'I Picked Up My Order' button as soon as customer clicks (optimistic update already handled via customerReceivedAt state).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth flow required per review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria for iteration 10 pass. Customer confirmation endpoint returns 404 for missing orders (not 405), confirming PUT+no-body handler exists. Bundle contains new strings. Only nit: unauth /my-orders shows infinite loading spinner rather than login prompt because loading state isn't cleared when customerId is null.
